purpose: Evaluate Stage C D0/D1/D3 reproducibility after imposing the frozen ETL diagnosis-date eligibility rule symmetrically on the PCORnet source phenotype.
relationship_to_primary_stage_c: This sensitivity does not replace or redefine the completed source-faithful Stage C analysis. The primary analysis asks whether a natural PCORnet phenotype reproduces after transformation; this sensitivity asks whether residual discordance remains after harmonizing diagnosis-date eligibility.

harmonized_rule.source_diagnosis_requirement: Qualifying PCORnet ischemic-stroke diagnosis must have non-null DX_DATE.
harmonized_rule.source_index_date: DX_DATE for qualifying diagnoses; encounter-date fallback is not allowed in this sensitivity.
harmonized_rule.omop_requirement: Lineage-faithful OMOP qualifying diagnosis must have the corresponding DIAGNOSIS lineage and materialized condition occurrence under the frozen ETL.
harmonized_rule.all_other_rules: Retain the locked Stage C D0/D1/D3 diagnosis codes, PDX=P, encounter types, calendar-overnight rule, adult rule, imaging definitions, lipid whitelist, evidence windows, and earliest-qualifying-event selection.

estimands: D0 patient counts, intersection, source-only, OMOP-only, Jaccard, and index-date agreement
D1 patient counts, intersection, source-only, OMOP-only, Jaccard, and index-date agreement
D3 patient counts, intersection, source-only, OMOP-only, Jaccard, and index-date agreement
interpretation: If harmonization materially improves concordance, the difference between the primary and harmonized analyses quantifies the contribution of the asymmetric diagnosis-date eligibility policy. Any residual disagreement after harmonization must be attributed separately rather than assumed to be a CDM effect.
